title: Jarvis says there are no past-deadline cases while the tile says 339, and shows the least serious cases as 'most serious first'

repro: npx vitest run --config vitest.qa4.config.ts tests/qa/pass4/same-number.test.ts -t same-number-1. By id: same-number-extras.json, list_order_adyar_weekly.

The correct total computed at screens.ts:426 is never reached.

what_happens: Saving a briefing as a workspace works and it is listed, with id 1000000001. Opening it answers 404 'Workspace not found.' The route takes ids of up to 9 digits, and a copy that does not save numbers its own rows from 1,000,000,000. So on every such copy (a teammate's clone, a test server) a saved workspace can never be reopened. The PC that saves to AWS gets lower ids and was not tested.

root_cause_guess: src/app/api/collector/workspaces/[id]/route.ts:10 against src/lib/aws/store.ts:298.
